Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String, pts() As Single
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ReDim pts(1 To 3, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 110: pts(2, 2) = 10: pts(3, 1) = 60: pts(3, 2) = 80: ws.Shapes.AddPolyline pts
    Case 1
        ReDim pts(1 To 4, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 110: pts(2, 2) = 10: pts(3, 1) = 60: pts(3, 2) = 80: pts(4, 1) = 10: pts(4, 2) = 10: ws.Shapes.AddPolyline pts
    Case 2
        ReDim pts(1 To 2, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 50: pts(1, 2) = 20: pts(2, 1) = 150: pts(2, 2) = 60: ws.Shapes.AddPolyline pts
    Case 3
        ReDim pts(1 To 1, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: ws.Shapes.AddPolyline pts
    Case 4
        ReDim pts(1 To 3, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 110: pts(2, 2) = 10: pts(3, 1) = 60: pts(3, 2) = 80: s = TypeName(ws.Shapes.AddPolyline(pts))
    Case 5
        ReDim pts(1 To 4, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 40: pts(2, 2) = 60: pts(3, 1) = 80: pts(3, 2) = 60: pts(4, 1) = 110: pts(4, 2) = 10: ws.Shapes.AddCurve pts
    Case 6
        ReDim pts(1 To 7, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 40: pts(2, 2) = 60: pts(3, 1) = 80: pts(3, 2) = 60: pts(4, 1) = 110: pts(4, 2) = 10: pts(5, 1) = 140: pts(5, 2) = -20: pts(6, 1) = 170: pts(6, 2) = 40: pts(7, 1) = 200: pts(7, 2) = 10: ws.Shapes.AddCurve pts
    Case 7
        ReDim pts(1 To 3, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 40: pts(2, 2) = 60: pts(3, 1) = 80: pts(3, 2) = 60: ws.Shapes.AddCurve pts
    Case 8
        ReDim pts(1 To 3, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10: pts(1, 2) = 10: pts(2, 1) = 110: pts(2, 2) = 10: pts(3, 1) = 60: pts(3, 2) = 80: ws.Shapes.AddPolyline(pts).Name = "Tri"
    Case 9
        ReDim pts(1 To 3, 1 To 2): pts(1, 1) = 10.5: pts(1, 2) = 10.25: pts(2, 1) = 110.75: pts(2, 2) = 10: pts(3, 1) = 60: pts(3, 2) = 80.5: ws.Shapes.AddPolyline pts
    End Select
    For Each sh In ws.Shapes: s = s & "|" & sh.Name & "," & sh.ID & "," & sh.Type & "," & sh.AutoShapeType & "," & sh.Left & "," & sh.Top & "," & sh.Width & "," & sh.Height: Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 9
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
